 Málaga CF vs. Racing Santander Moneyline Insights 
 Málaga CF has been a moneyline favorite only two other times so far this season, and went 0-2-0 in those games.
 This season Racing Santander has won one of the eight games in which it has been an underdog.
 Málaga CF has played as a moneyline favorite of +137 or shorter in just one game this season, which they drew.
 This season, Racing Santander has been at least a +182 underdog on the moneyline seven times, losing each of those contests.
